entities.summary: Roman Republic, a political institution in Holy See during Papal States – Decline & Loss of Temporal Power (1815–1870). Grew from Pope Pius VI dies a prisoner of France at Valence and French Revolution. Led to the emergence of First Vatican Council declares papal infallibility and Italian troops breach Porta Pia and capture Rome.
